title: Rom Spaceknight #38 Marvel 1983 Shang-Chi Master of Kung Fu 1st Doctor Dredd
condition_description: Bright cover, light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Rom #38 (January 1983), Marvel Comics - Rom the Spaceknight with Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu, in a stained-glass cathedral full of Dire Wraith gargoyles. First appearance of Doctor Dredd. Bill Mantlo story. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Dune Buggy ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
